name: Fear & Greed momentum continuation — ride confirmed greed in a bull regime
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (the OPPOSITE-SIGN read of fear-greed-contrarian-buy-extreme-fear, which BUYS extreme FEAR; this rides moderate-to-strong GREED as trend confirmation): the crowd-sentiment contrarian edge lives only at the TAILS — buy capitulation, fade euphoria. In the MIDDLE-TO-HIGH band, sentiment is PROCYCLICAL: rising, confirmed greed marks a self-reinforcing bull regime where flows beget flows, and the index leads continuation rather than reversal until it reaches the euphoric extreme. So the honest decomposition is: extreme-low → contrarian long (the existing spec), extreme-high → fade, and the MIDDLE-high band → momentum confirmation (this spec). Enter on greed ABOVE a confirmation floor but BELOW a euphoria ceiling (a fitted band via two conditions), in an uptrend — riding the procyclical zone and stepping aside before the blow-off the contrarian short would fade. Entry: fear_greed above a fitted greed floor AND fear_greed below a fitted euphoria ceiling AND price in an uptrend. Exit: fear_greed crosses UP through the euphoria ceiling (entering the fade zone — get out) OR crosses DOWN below the greed floor (regime cooling) — whichever fires; plus stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if an unconditional momentum long matches the deflated Sharpe, the greed band adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: if the euphoria ceiling never binds (optimizer pushes it to 100), the band thesis is unsupported and this is just 'greed + momentum'. Disconfirmer 3: this is the directional inverse of fear-greed-contrarian — together they must NOT be double-counted as independent edges (same feature, partitioned regime). Disconfirmer 4 (cost): must clear ~20bps round-trip net. tier0 sentiment feature (~1000 daily points).
catalyst: confirmed (non-euphoric) greed in an uptrend — procyclical sentiment continuation
